original_benchmark.notes: Shopping levels 1 and 2 only: 50 cases each. Travel and Shopping level 3 are outside this adapter scope.

harbor_adapter.notes: Draft adapter. All 100 oracle trials passed on Harbor 0.25.0 with local Smol 1.32.4 and separate verifiers. The native ShoppingFnAgent wrapper runs unchanged upstream code and passed scripted loopback-SDK checks on one task per level with isolated grading. Model parity and registration are pending. Terminal transport delegates to unchanged upstream tools. Level 1 case 36 uses the released dataset size-44 query.
